_README: VERIFIED crop-rects for the 5 owner-added asset packs, hand-labeled by Claude via grid-crop inspection. Each pack is a 1408x768 JPG (NO alpha — extraction must key on the gray mockup background color, like preprocessShowcaseSheet does for the boss JPGs; gray bg color is given per sheet). Coordinates are {sx,sy,sw,sh} in that sheet. These are AI-generated mockups with drop shadows + slight JPG softening, so expect to TRIM a few px and tune in-engine. 'rec' = recommended sprite for the game.

toll_booth._use: OWNER DECISION = use BOTH: a backdrop billboard along the top edge + barrier arms across the lane.

tollbooth_front.note: FLAT front elevation of the toll plaza — best as the top-edge backdrop billboard (reads head-on, unlike the isometric one)

tollbooth_iso.note: isometric 3-D plaza — alt backdrop; perspective clashes with top-down, use only if you prefer the look

barrier_arm_down.note: horizontal red/white arm — lay across a lane to block it

guardrail_h.note: horizontal seamless straight section incl. posts — TILE horizontally. Trim the empty top/bottom to the rail band (~sy 150, sh ~110) for a tight tile

guardrail_v.note: vertical straight section — tile vertically (Ch shoulders that run N-S)

road_satellite.note: top-down asphalt road tile w/ lane markings + MERGE arrow — great as a road backdrop for Ch2/Ch5

hottub.note: full spa/pool composite (coping + water + ladder + jet panel). Use as the Ch8 hottub sprite

water_h.note: tileable water surface (2 tiles — halve for one ~170x156)

arcade_cabinet.note: full front-view cabinet — use as the Ch8 arcade sprite

cars._use: RECOMMENDATION: for the generic-car stubs in Ch2/Ch6, reuse the existing 3 hero cars (prop_nick_f_corolla / prop_jordan_mustang / prop_maharko_camero) — they're cleaner. The top-down cars below are embedded in a parking-lot SCENE on dark asphalt, so extraction must key out the asphalt (dark gray) + parking lines; expect messier results. Optional/bonus.

car_blue.note: top-down blue sedan (in parking space; approx — trim asphalt)

_STILL_MISSING.firepit: No firepit pack was provided. Keep the Ch8 firepit PROCEDURAL (stone ring + flame particles via the scene's particle system) until/unless a firepit sprite is added.
